summary: D1 policy-engine revise-apply 089 resolves D1-RA-001 (P1): next() bypassed the Verification-facts gate before review-apply. findingsAddressed.title: next() bypasses the Verification-facts gate before review-apply
findingsAddressed.rootCause: src/policy/next.ts decideApplyStage: the !lineage.match branch returned actionResult('review-apply') without calling isVerificationFactAvailable(snapshot). In the C1 snapshot (no Change Verification status), canRun(review-apply) via preconditions.reviewSPreconditions adds 'verification-facts-unavailable' for the apply stage (line 271-273), so canRun correctly rejects. But next() returned action: review-apply, contradicting its own canRun contract. The approved-review archive branch already had the verification gate (after the revise-apply branch), but the no-lineage review-apply branch did not.
findingsAddressed.fix: Added the verification gate to the !lineage.match branch in decideApplyStage: if (!isVerificationFactAvailable(snapshot)) return blockedResult(verificationFactsUnavailableDiagnosis()); else return actionResult('review-apply'). The gate mirrors canRun(review-apply) exactly. Critically, the gate is placed ONLY on the !lineage.match branch — NOT hoisted above the revise-apply (match+changes-requested) branch — because canRun(revise-apply) (reviseSPreconditions) does not require Verification facts, and hoisting would make next() block revise-apply while canRun(revise-apply) allows it (a new inconsistency). The approved-review archive gate (after the revise-apply branch) is unchanged.
findingsAddressed.verificationEvidence: next.ts:214-226: !lineage.match branch now checks isVerificationFactAvailable → blocked: verification-facts-unavailable before action: review-apply. next.test.ts:340-361 'apply artifact, no review → blocked verification-facts-unavailable (D1-7)' asserts blocked (was action). next.test.ts:460-518 lifecycle Step 6 asserts blocked (was action: review-apply); Step 7 removed (unreachable in D1 since Step 6 is blocked). preconditions.ts unchanged (canRun path already correct per 088). 406/406 tests pass. In D1, isVerificationFactAvailable always false → next() always returns blocked for the review-apply path, matching canRun(review-apply).allowed=false.
